name: Tennis
description: Singles or doubles racquet sport on a hard, clay, or grass court.

name: Badminton
description: Indoor shuttlecock racquet sport, played as singles or doubles.

name: Squash
description: Fast-paced racquet sport played in an enclosed four-walled court.

name: Table Tennis
description: Indoor paddle sport played across a table with a small lightweight ball.

name: Pickleball
description: Paddle sport combining elements of tennis, badminton, and ping pong.

name: Padel
description: Racquet sport played in doubles inside a glass-walled court.

name: Basketball
description: Full-court or half-court ball sport; commonly played 3v3 or 5v5.

name: Volleyball
description: Net sport played indoors or on sand with two opposing teams.

name: Soccer
description: Field sport played with two teams; goals score one point each.

name: Futsal
description: Five-a-side indoor variant of soccer, played on a hard court.

name: Cricket
description: Bat-and-ball sport between two teams of eleven, played on a pitch.

name: Baseball
description: Bat-and-ball sport played on a diamond between two teams of nine.

name: Field Hockey
description: Team sport played on grass or turf with curved sticks and a hard ball.

name: Ultimate Frisbee
description: Non-contact team sport played with a flying disc on a rectangular field.

name: Golf
description: Course-based sport played with clubs; lower stroke totals win.

name: Running
description: Solo or group endurance activity timed across set distances.

name: Swimming
description: Pool-based timed sport across multiple stroke and distance categories.

name: Cycling
description: Road or track endurance sport timed across a set route or distance.
